CustomField.description: Formula displaying the alternative distribution Contact's name when present; otherwise displays the original inventor's name.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( IP_AlternativeContact__r.FirstName ), IP_Original_Inventor_Name__r.FirstName + " " + IP_Original_Inventor_Name__r.LastName, IP_AlternativeContact__r.FirstName + " " + IP_AlternativeContact__r.LastName )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only current recipient name; an Alternative Distribution Contact overrides the Original Inventor.
CustomField.label: Inventor
